in_sanskrit.name: Dalpati
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Brave in battle
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dalpati एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Dalpati is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dal’ (to strike) and ‘pati’ (lord). This name is given to a brave warrior or a fearless leader. It is often used as a name for boys born into warrior or royal families.
